insufficiency_reason: Sources discuss general fruit-pumpkin drip-irrigation recommendations and fixed weekly water amounts but do not provide soil-moisture-based irrigation scheduling criteria for seed pumpkin. No source establishes measurement thresholds, sensor placement logic, or a decision method that uses soil moisture readings to replace a fixed irrigation calendar for seed-purpose Cucurbita. Utah Extension gives a generic 1-2 inches-per-week rule (d5-e7), Alabama recommends drip over overhead without scheduling detail (d3-e7), and Virginia Tech notes pre-plant/establishment irrigation only (d2-e5); none deliver the requested soil-moisture-trigger methodology, nor do they address the seed-harvest product specifically.
